title: Contract formation and defenses — six agreements

rows.label: A 16-year-old agrees to buy a gaming computer on credit
An oral agreement to sell a vacant lot for $80,000
rows.explanation: Land sales are within the statute of frauds.

rows.label: An agreement to pay someone to commit arson
rows.explanation: Contracts for illegal purposes are void.

rows.label: A seller lies about a car's mileage to induce the sale
rows.explanation: Fraud in the inducement makes it voidable by the victim.

rows.label: An oral agreement to paint a house within 3 months for $6,000
rows.explanation: Services performable within a year needn't be in writing.

rows.label: A buyer signs under threat of physical harm
Between merchants, does a written confirmation not objected to within 10 days satisfy the statute of frauds against the recipient?
Does a merchant's signed, written promise to hold an offer open for 60 days need consideration?
rows.explanation: UCC firm offers are irrevocable without consideration for up to 3 months.
